insights/queries allTasks (runs analytical queries on Viva Insights data) plus supportTickets; serves business analytics, no service config
skypeForBusiness allTasks and teams/callQuality read for troubleshooting, plus serviceHealth; support function like Teams Communications Support Specialist
viva.glint allEntities allTasks: bounded administration of the Viva Glint workload; support and report reads do not decide
directory/backup standard read plus preview create/cancel; backup reader, no restore or recovery write

microsoft.viva.goals allTasks; bounded administration of one Viva app, not a big content workload.

isPrivileged floor; users/disable, enable, invalidateAllRefreshTokens, password/update: identity containment and credential reset.

teams/callQuality standard/read plus skypeForBusiness troubleshooting tools and serviceHealth; support role like Teams Communications Support Engineer.
isPrivileged; domains federation update, onPremisesSynchronization, passwordHashSync, hybridAuthenticationPolicy, applications/servicePrincipals writes.

graph.dataConnect/allEntities/allProperties/allTasks plus support/serviceHealth: bounded administration of the Graph Data Connect service; not an anchored full-content workload admin.
